item.title: Layers 0.1.4
item.description: Redesign the menu-bar popup with a compact 600 × 560 layout and clear Layers, Apps and Settings tabs. Group profiles by application, with layer search and a running-only filter for faster switching. Keep opening, quitting, creating and managing profiles accessible in tighter rows. Simplify app discovery and settings for the smaller popup while preserving the full desktop layout. Supports macOS 14 Sonoma and later on Apple Silicon and Intel.
